name: Lost Survey Camp
prompt: Single complete landscape 16:9 location painting for FREEBORN, a dark text RPG. Immersive eye-level environmental view as if physically standing here, deep spatial perspective, readable silhouettes. Painterly industrial noir oil/gouache, textured but detailed, grounded retro-industrial science fiction. Restrained charcoal, bone, rust, cold steel blue and warm amber lamps; weather, wet surfaces and distinctive architecture, subtle unnatural estuary ecology. Strong place-specific focal point. No words, readable signs, labels, UI, borders, collage, logos or watermark. No prominent humans or monsters; occupants appear separately in the game. The world outside civilization can be wild and desolate. Do not paint quest instructions or numeric game statistics. Keep main features within central 85 percent for responsive fit. Every scene must depict this specific place, never a generic backdrop. Location: Lost Survey Camp. Region: The Long Dike. Physical description for inspiration: Collapsed canvas clings to rusted poles. A cold kettle still hangs above the fire pit, and the survey stakes now point into water too deep to cross. Visual continuity: A continuous uninhabited outer dike landscape, gravel embankments, coarse grass, blackwater creeks, reeds and skeletal power lines; overcast dusk. Adjacent places in the actual map: n connects to Salt Meadow; s connects to Flood Marker; w connects to Reed Hide. Depict logical connected paths or openings without signs, arrows or labels.
